subject.title: Control UI: Worktrees mutation errors disappear during refresh

question: Which of the three open candidate fixes should be the canonical landing path for this Worktrees error-persistence bug?
rationale: The behavior is clearly broken and does not need a product decision, but overlapping candidates differ in scope and proof; the protected label requires a maintainer to select and land one implementation.

options.title: Land the live-proven candidate
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106196, which includes authenticated Gateway reproduction plus component and browser coverage.

options.title: Land the narrower component candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106190 if its scoped loader API and rendered-callout tests are preferred after comparison.

options.title: Adopt the minimal loader change
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106199 only if maintainers confirm that preserving errors across every successful load is intentional.

recommendation.title: Land the live-proven candidate
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106196, which includes authenticated Gateway reproduction plus component and browser coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the strongest real-behavior evidence and own the most comprehensively validated candidate.
